the Riccati equation approach is the most efficient and effective approach in the literature, but the SDP approach can be used as an alternative, especially in the cases where the Riccati approach cannot be used.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LQ control problem with an indefinite cost can be formulated as an SDP, and the SDP can be solved efficiently by interior--point methods.
we have developed a new theory for the infinite-horizon stochastic LQ problem, which is a significant extension of the deterministic LQ problem.

, we have shown that, in contrast to the deterministic case, the SDP approach is a natural way for solving the stochastic LQ control problems, and it is not only a useful tool for numerical computation but also a powerful theoretical tool.

the SDP approach can replace the Riccati equation method in many cases.
